name: Gmail
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Gmail API enabled, and one account’s refresh token for this scope under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: gmail.modify, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

pick.name: list_messages
pick.says: Lists the mailbox’s messages as an id and threadId each; get_message returns one’s content. q takes Gmail search-box syntax, e.g. from:ann@example.com is:unread, and userId is me.

pick.name: get_message
pick.says: Returns one message; userId is me. format is full (the default: headers and body parts in payload, each body’s data base64url-encoded), metadata (labels and headers only, those in metadataHeaders if given), minimal or raw.

pick.name: list_threads
pick.says: Lists the mailbox’s conversations without their messages; get_thread returns one’s messages. q takes Gmail search-box syntax, e.g. from:ann@example.com is:unread, and userId is me.

pick.name: get_thread
pick.says: Returns one conversation with all its messages; userId is me. format is full (the default: headers and body parts in payload, each body’s data base64url-encoded), metadata (labels and headers only, those in metadataHeaders if given) or minimal.

pick.name: list_labels
pick.says: Lists the mailbox’s labels, system and user, each with its id, name and type; those ids are what labelIds and modify_message_labels take. userId is me.

pick.name: get_label
pick.says: Returns one label with its total and unread counts of messages and threads. userId is me.

pick.name: list_drafts
pick.says: Lists drafts as an id each, with only the id and threadId of its message; get_draft returns one’s content. q takes Gmail search-box syntax, and userId is me.

pick.name: get_draft
pick.says: Returns one draft and its message; userId is me. format is full (the default: headers and body parts in payload, each body’s data base64url-encoded), metadata, minimal or raw.

pick.name: get_profile
pick.says: Returns the signed-in account’s email address and its total messages and threads. userId is me.

pick.name: send_message
pick.says: Sends an email to the recipients in its To, Cc and Bcc headers; userId is me. A reply stays in its thread only with the thread’s threadId, In-Reply-To and References headers in the raw message, and the same Subject. Body: {"raw": "<base64url of an RFC 2822 message>", "threadId"}.

pick.name: create_draft
pick.says: Saves an email as a draft without sending it; userId is me. A reply stays in its thread as in send_message. Body: {"message": {"raw": "<base64url of an RFC 2822 message>", "threadId"}}.

pick.name: modify_message_labels
pick.says: Adds or removes labels on one message, up to 100 of each, by the ids list_labels returns, INBOX and UNREAD included; userId is me. Body: {"addLabelIds": [label ids], "removeLabelIds": [label ids]}.

pick.name: create_label
pick.says: Creates a user label, whose name may not be a system label’s; userId is me. Body: {"name", "labelListVisibility": "labelShow", "messageListVisibility": "show"}.
